title: USS Delarov disc rises from sea near Adak
summary: Richard Dolan tells of USS Delarov disc rises from sea near Adak, about 1945 at near Adak Island, Aleutian Islands, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that, but other people did see it emerge from the water. It's a discshaped object about 200 feet in diameter.

plain: A writer on UFO history, Richard Dolan, tells of an incident in 1945 near Adak Island, in the Aleutian Islands off Alaska, involving a US Navy ship called the USS Delarov. Drawing on accounts from a man named Robert Crawford and from the researcher James McDonald, he says people aboard saw a disc-shaped object about 200 feet wide rise up out of the water. If true, it would mean such craft were coming and going from the sea even before the modern UFO era.
